title: Gallery
summary: An ordered media collection shown in an inline Slider, with an optional Modal lightbox holding a second Slider. The gallery owns the one-based current slide and keeps both views on it.

template.description: Template variant name for SfBaseElement external templates.

root-class.description: Classes added to the root element the component draws.

root-style.description: Inline style declarations set on the root element the component draws, custom properties included.

modal-id.description: Passed to the lightbox's sf-modal: the window's id, which data-sf-modal-close and data-sf-modal-hide controls name. Empty: a path id.

heading.description: Passed to the lightbox's sf-modal: the window's title in its header. Empty: «Галерея» on a Russian page, «Gallery» on an English one.

text.description: Passed to the lightbox's sf-modal: plain text in the window's body when there is no slide.

inline.description: Shows the slides on the page (true, the default). false with lightbox shows them only in the full-screen window.

lightbox.description: Opens a slide in a full-screen window (an sf-modal) when it is pressed (true, the default).

arrows.description: Passed to the gallery's sliders (sf-slider): draws the previous and next arrows.

dots.description: Passed to the gallery's sliders (sf-slider): draws the dots under the slides (off by default: the thumbnails show the place).

thumbs.description: Passed to the gallery's sliders (sf-slider): draws the row of thumbnails under the slides (on by default).

loop.description: Passed to the gallery's sliders (sf-slider): the last slide is followed by the first.

space-between.description: Passed to the gallery's sliders (sf-slider): the gap between slides in pixels. Unset (the default), the slider's own gap, the --sf-space-1 step (16 on a desktop, 12 on a phone).

speed.description: Passed to the gallery's sliders (sf-slider): the length of a slide's move, in milliseconds.

button-type.description: Passed to the gallery's sliders (sf-slider): the arrow buttons' colour scheme, an sf-button-icon scheme.

button-size.description: Passed to the gallery's sliders (sf-slider): the arrow buttons' size step.

dots-type.description: Passed to the gallery's sliders (sf-slider): The dots' plate by its colour role: primary-container (the default; a primary-container plate with on-primary-container dots), primary (a primary plate with on-primary dots), surface-container (a raised neutral plate with on-surface dots), surface-inverse (an inverse plate with on-surface-inverse dots). Former words, dated aliases until 2027-01-01: primary-dark is primary-container, primary-light is primary, light and clear are surface-container, dark is surface-inverse.

dots-size.description: Passed to the gallery's sliders (sf-slider): the dots' size step.

thumbs-class.description: Passed to the gallery's sliders (sf-slider): classes on the thumbnails row.

thumb-class.description: Passed to the gallery's sliders (sf-slider): classes on each thumbnail.

slide-class.description: Passed to the gallery's sliders (sf-slider): classes on each slide.

inline-class.description: Classes on the slider shown on the page.

lightbox-class.description: Classes on the slider in the full-screen window.

overlay.description: Passed to the lightbox's sf-modal: draws the scrim behind the window.

show-header.description: Passed to the lightbox's sf-modal: draws the window's header with the heading and its buttons.

show-close.description: Passed to the lightbox's sf-modal: draws the close button in the header.

close-on-esc.description: Passed to the lightbox's sf-modal: Escape closes the window.

close-on-overlay.description: Passed to the lightbox's sf-modal: a press on the scrim closes the window.

preserve-scroll-gap.description: Passed to the lightbox's sf-modal: while the page is locked, keeps the scrollbar's width so the page does not shift.

position.description: Passed to the lightbox's sf-modal: where the window stands: center, or a side panel at left, right, top or bottom.

fullscreen.description: Passed to the lightbox's sf-modal: the window takes the whole viewport.

width.description: Passed to the lightbox's sf-modal: the window's width, a CSS length.

height.description: Passed to the lightbox's sf-modal: the window's height, a CSS length.

backdrop-blur.description: Passed to the lightbox's sf-modal: blurs the page behind the scrim, by blur-type.

blur-type.description: Passed to the lightbox's sf-modal: the blur's strength: none, small, medium (the default) or large.

overlay-class.description: Passed to the lightbox's sf-modal: classes on the scrim.

close-class.description: Passed to the lightbox's sf-modal: classes on the close button.

surface-class.description: Passed to the lightbox's sf-modal: classes on the window's surface.

surface-padding.description: Passed to the lightbox's sf-modal: the surface's padding, a CSS length.

panel-class.description: Passed to the lightbox's sf-modal: classes on the panel that holds the surface.

header-class.description: Passed to the lightbox's sf-modal: classes on the header.

body-class.description: Passed to the lightbox's sf-modal: classes on the body's scrolling area.

content-class.description: Passed to the lightbox's sf-modal: classes on the wrapper of the slides.

footer-class.description: Passed to the lightbox's sf-modal: classes on the footer.

open.summary: Moves to the given one-based slide when an index is passed, sets open and opens the lightbox modal. Returns the element.

close.summary: Removes open and closes the lightbox modal. Returns the element.

toggle.summary: Calls close() when open, open(index) otherwise. Returns the element.

goTo.summary: Moves to a one-based slide, clamped to the slide count, reflects it to the current attribute, syncs both sliders and dispatches the native change event when it moved. Returns the element.

next.summary: goTo(current + 1); stops at the last slide. Returns the element.

prev.summary: goTo(current - 1); stops at the first slide. Returns the element.

getModal.summary: Returns the lightbox sf-modal, or null when there is none.

getInlineSlider.summary: Returns the inline sf-slider, or null before render.

getLightboxSlider.summary: Returns the lightbox sf-slider, or null when there is none.

sf-change.summary: The current slide changed through the API or either slider. Bubbles and is composed.

sf-close.summary: The lightbox modal finished closing. Bubbles and is composed.

sf-open.summary: The lightbox modal finished opening. Bubbles and is composed.

accessibility.focus: Keep visible focus on the active control.

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-gallery for one ordered media collection with one-based current state, an inline Slider and optional Modal lightbox. Nested Sliders inherit token-driven spacing, reduced-motion behavior, autoplay pause and hidden-slide focus protection unless the author supplies explicit compatibility overrides.
do_not: The rendered Gallery root permits shrinking in grid/flex via min-width:0. Do not hide document overflow or reset Slider instances to compensate for parent intrinsic sizing; explicit author widths remain the author's responsive-layout responsibility.

current/open-only updates preserve the existing inline Slider and use updateMode:dom. Observe sf-updated for these state changes, not sf-after-render. Actual configuration and slot changes still render; do not recreate unchanged slide content just to open Modal.

Load the Gallery composition CSS declared by cl-gallery. Do not overwrite projected figure/image/caption inline styles. Reuse Slider dimension/fit tokens, --sf-gallery-media--max-height and Modal scrolling for long content; width/height/fullscreen remain Modal options.

Gallery owns the selected position across inline/lightbox rendering. Use its one-based current/goTo/open API; do not maintain a second current index on nested Sliders or repair their position with delayed callbacks.

Slide counts and inline/lightbox indices use meaningful slot items, excluding formatting whitespace and comments. Keep composite cards inside one attributed root or one child of a bare slot container; do not treat each sibling heading or link as part of an inferred card.
Do not copy generated ui-smart code
Do not move host data or access decisions into the component
